baseline.note: The option_list construction API is deprecated; the optparse module remains supported. This is an owner-approved parser standardization, not a security or runtime-EOL claim.

target.outcome: Replace the parser component while preserving settlement CLI compatibility contract v1.0.

acceptance: The fixed transaction batch produces the unchanged golden CSV report.
Retain all supported CLI flags, standard-stream defaults, attached values, unique long-option abbreviations and last-value semantics.
Keep hyphen-prefixed and option-looking filenames as option values.
Keep inclusive date filtering and validate every row before date/currency filtering.
Keep per-transaction half-up cent rounding, refunds, zero amounts and separate sorted customer/currency groups.
Keep validation and failure exit codes; invalid input produces no report and preserves existing output.
Keep UTF-8 file input, BOM, quoting, multiline fields, LF report bytes and exact version output.
Change only settlement.py; protected business logic, test evidence and contract remain unchanged.
Remove optparse import and construct/use argparse for the actual CLI; an unused import is insufficient.
Characterization and target acceptance pass on supplied Python 3.10 and 3.13 environments.

delivery.human_approval: Approve the exact candidate after independent review and fresh check evidence.
delivery.application: Apply only through an explicit separate action; no automatic merge or deployment.
delivery.rollback: Retain the captured Git baseline. The developer reviews and performs normal Git revert/restore if needed; no automatic rollback of outputs, consumers or deployments.

measurement.note: This manifest describes a reproducible exercise. It is not consumed as a new Parallax API contract, proof of market demand or a live-provider result.
